material_type.evidence: Two FFPE tumor sections per sample were deparaffinized and added to the vials, and homogenized with two 20 s cycles at 5,800 rpm in a precooled Precellys ball mill (Bertin Technologies).

sample_source.evidence: inferred: We included 953 patients with adenocarcinoma of the esophagus who underwent surgery between 2013 and 2019 at the Department of General, Visceral, Cancer, and Transplantation Surgery of the University Hospital Cologne with curative intent.
